title: Are We There Yet?
intro: Three corridors, one program. They have different lengths, so counting won't save you. [b]while[/b] keeps repeating its body as long as its condition is true. Your program has to pass all three maps.
cs_note: A [b]while loop[/b] runs until its condition becomes false. Checking a sensor is free, but a loop whose condition never changes runs forever. Each map is a [b]test case[/b]: code that passes one test isn't necessarily correct.
hints: Use the tabs above the maze to look at every map before you write code.
while path_ahead(): move() walks until the wall. Then turn and do it again.

Every map is a corridor east and then a corridor north, only with different lengths. The first [b]while path_ahead()[/b] with a move() inside walks east to the wall, whatever its length. turn_left() faces north, and a second while walks up to the exit, where the run ends.
